inputs.original_text:
Folks, we are witnessing the exact kind of institutional rot that happens when the foundational pillars of duty, family, and national continuity are abandoned for elite self-interest. Look at the situation in Nigeria right now, where their political parties—which ought to stand as the backbone of traditional representation and public service—are devolving into exclusive country clubs for the ultra-wealthy. 

Take a hard look at the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) and their preparations ahead of the 2027 general elections. It is painfully clear that personal ambition and cash are actively replacing basic civic accountability, moral duty, and true community representation. When these institutions turn their backs on their foundational responsibilities to serve the people and instead cater purely to the wealthy elite, social order inevitably collapses and the traditional fabric of society pays the heavy price. This is the bitter fruit of a system where money replaces moral duty.
